Results.ReviewText: Excellent, functional and cute! I am super happy about this grill and because it is quick and everything gets cooked to perfection, I am grilling more often! Simply love it!
Results.Title: Absolutely another level of grilling!

We are sure to pass your feedback to the appropriate team. Thanks!

Results.ReviewText: Grill works awesome but will rust out soo quickly with no customer support. The frane on mine rotten to nothing after a couple years despite always being covered. Poor design at the bottom of the frame allowing moisture to sit.
Results.Title: Works awesome but will rust !!

Results.ReviewText: Solidly built,  lights reliably,  and nice looking to boot! Of course,  it cost five times what I paid for my old cheapo grill 10 years ago!
Results.Title: Pay more,  get more

Results.ReviewText: Very compact. Very good heat applications to the foods.  Tank was a little hard to put in the case but manageable.
Results.Title: Good buy.

Results.ReviewText: Good grill but the lid paint is flaking off after one year. Also the upper warming rack rusted in 6 months.
Results.Title: Good Grill But

Results.ReviewText: This grill is perfect for us!  There are just two of us and it's the perfect size for a couple of burgers or some hot dogs, a couple of steaks or chicken breasts.  Perfect size!  It heats up fast!  With both burners going full speed, it gets up to 550 degrees in about 10 minutes or less.  And I love the grease catcher under the burners, too.  Keeps the inside of the grill clean and the grease easy to dispose of.  Love it!
Results.Title: Prefect size, heats up fast, very convenient!

Results.ReviewText: Replacing my old Spirit grill, which finally gave out after 8 years of hard work. Big enough for meals for two plus the regular get togethers of our extended family of 12. Will only buy Weber - the other brands just don’t hold up. Only wish this still came in stainless, as it’s predecessor did.
Results.Title: Forever Weber

Results.ReviewText: Weber is the best. I have been using weber grill since 1986 and have taken them all over the world with me. Great products
Results.Title: Weber is the best

Results.ReviewText: I found the Spirit E-210 Gas Grill was easy to assemble myself, and it fits nicely on my small patio.  I replaced a 20-year-old three burner Weber with this grill which takes up less space and features an electronic starter which my old grill did not have.  I like that the cabinet hides the propane tank, as well as the pop-up side tables.  The grill starts easily and gets up to cooking temperature quickly.  I have used it for direct heat grilling for steaks and burgers, as well as indirect heat for baked potatoes.
Results.Title: Fantastic small grill for home grilling

Results.ReviewText: We're really enjoying our new Weber Spirit gas grill. It is compact and efficient.
Results.Title: We love our Weber Spirit grill!

Results.ReviewText:
I purchased this grill two weeks ago.  It was well packaged and was easy to assemble.  I had trouble gettting the grill to heat to 500F.  The unit seemed cold.  I wrote a negative review.  I later discovered that it was operator error!  I had turned the burner knobs all the way counter clockwise thinking that I was selecting the "High" setting when this was actually the low setting.  Problem solved.   I now have no problem heating the grill to 500F. 

I am happy with this grill and highly recommend it.
Results.Title: Update Review.

Results.ReviewText: Lots of cooking surface for its size. Folding shelves make for better storage.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: A high quality grill that cooks food evenly.  Very happy with my purchase!
Results.Title: Happy purchaser

Results.ReviewText: Assembly is a pain, if you can get it assembled by the seller go for it.  Directions are great but just a pain to do yourself.  Other than that I love the grill….
Results.Title: Assembly!

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill. My only complaint is that the drip tray is very difficult to remove and replace. The gas line hangs right in front of it.   Other than that I have no complaints.
Results.Title: Good grill

Results.ReviewText: This is our first gas grill and we love it, so easy to cook and clean up
Results.Title: love to grill

Results.ReviewText: Weber is best grill to buy. I bought it because of the longevity compared to other grills and had great customer service when replacing a part.
Results.Title: Quality

Results.ReviewText: This is a sweetheart of a grill. I’ve used my Weber charcoal grill for fifty years and will continue to do so. Gas grilling is a new world for me and I’m loving the new unit and it’s ease of use. Love the results!
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.ReviewText:
Evenly heated cooking surface. I have cooked everything from hotdogs, burgers, and corn to a full chicken on this grill, with everything coming out perfectly. 

Word of caution though, If you cook something like a chicken, that expels a ton of fat, you’ll need to clean the grill’s base.. otherwise, the next time you grill, it’ll be flair up city. Luckily, cleaning this grill is absolutely easy to do. 

I love it.
Results.Title: Fantastic grill

Results.ReviewText: I really like the grill.  The single bad feature is the "hook" you are supposed to hang your gas tank from to enable the gas gauge.  Terrible design.  Extremely difficult.  I cut a piece of wood to fit  under the cabinet since the hole you have in floor of cabinet won't hold a gas tank.  The grill is great - the hook feature to hang gas tank from is stupid.
Results.Title: poor design

Results.ReviewText: Perfect size for two people. Easy to assemble. Easy to use. Easy to clean. We love it!
Results.Title: Perfect!

Results.ReviewText:
I have used it twice so far and the results  were perfect.
The design is so good with the foil drain pans and under feeding pan is best I have ever seen.
Results.Title: Best

Results.ReviewText: The Spirit E-210 is easy to use and cooks beautifully.
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.ReviewText: Nice grill  , Works great Only had for a few months no problems. Live in Florida we'll see how it last  Over the next year With the way our weather is
Results.Title: Does the job

Results.ReviewText: This rating is only for grilling, this was a nice upgrade from my old Master Forge. Both grills are two burners, but the Weber gets hotter and puts a nice char on my steaks. My Master Forge is eight years old and it's still working, but rust has taken its toll on this grill. I will see how this Weber lasts under the same storage conditions; covered and stored outside on my deck in Michigan winter weather.
Results.Title: Nice Upgrade

Results.ReviewText: I replaced another brand, which served me fine for 4 seasons, then had many problems that would require parts replacement to bring back to full features. But the parts would cost almost as much as a new grill. After another 2 seasons of workaround I decided to replace. Although the Weber was more expensive I decided to purchase instead of another of the other brand. Very happy I did!
Results.Title: First Weber grill purchased

Results.ReviewText: The grill is everything that I expected, the only thing the apparatus that tells me how much propane is left was missing. It does not effect the performance of the grill, so it hasn't been that big a deal. Just surprised....
Results.Title: Happy user

Results.ReviewText: First time Weber owner. The difference between a Weber and lesser brands is evident right away. Really enjoying our new grill.
Results.Title: Weber grill

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
